bowl_in_plate: Pick up the bowl and place it in the plate.
empty_basket: Remove the two toys from the basket in any order.
open_lid: Pick up the lid on the pot and place it on the table.
pick_cube: Lift the cube above the table.
press_toaster: Press the toaster down to the bottom.
push_cube: Push the cube away from its original position.
stack_cups: Stack the red cup on the dark blue cup, then stack the light blue cup on top.
toys_in_basket: Pick up the two toys and place them in the basket in any order.
toys_in_drawer: Pick up the panda toy and place it in the drawer, then close the drawer.
